name: Android P-002 plan-item status precedence: mutation probe of PlansScreen.kt against PlanItemsContractTest
summary: Mutation probe run from the papercusp root (cwd '.') against the sibling checkout papercup-rust-mobile at 87df4157006f2e56ec67cce66cdc6c3dca4ad9e8. That commit's android/app/src, crates and Cargo.lock content equals c37edfc7625337e433abb9f5451f433635cdc54a, the commit of the companion tree proof docs/evidence/android-p002-contract-current-2026-10-06.json. The mutation collapses the Kotlin plan-item status precedence (effectiveStatus, then storedStatus, then status) to the legacy 'status' key only. Baseline guard exited 0; mutant guard exited 1, with PlanItemsContractTest readsStoredStatusFromCurrentServerShape and effectiveStatusWinsOverStoredStatusWhenServerSendsIt failing. Verdict: caught, as expected. Overlay relocation means the tracked file was never modified. Disclosed: at run time a peer had an uncommitted edit in crates/papercup-bindings/src/lib.rs. The JVM host unit test exercised here does not compile or load that Rust file.

assertions.evidence: The unmutated guard (PlanItemsContractTest, testDebugUnitTest --rerun) exited 0 under the probe's baseline phase.

With the status-precedence mutation bound over PlansScreen.kt via bwrap overlay, the guard exited 1: readsStoredStatusFromCurrentServerShape FAILED and effectiveStatusWinsOverStoredStatusWhenServerSendsIt FAILED. The mutation probe reported verdict caught (expected caught).
PlansScreen.kt sha256 26b20649… and PlanItemsContractTest.kt sha256 a60cb2bf… are identical to the hashes recorded in the companion tree proof at c37edfc.
